title: Finding Domain and Range from a Graph of Oil Production
body: Find the domain and range of the function f whose graph is shown in the image.\n##figure1.gif

figureAlts.figure1.gif: Line chart titled Alaska Crude Oil Production. The horizontal axis shows years, with tick labels from 1975 to 2005 in steps of 5 years, and the plotted line extends slightly before 1975 and slightly after 2005. The vertical axis is labeled Thousand barrels per day and ranges from 0 to 2200 in steps of 200. The line starts around 220 thousand barrels per day in the early 1970s, dips to its lowest point of about 170 around 1976, rises sharply through the late 1970s and early 1980s, reaches its highest point of about 2000 around 1988, then generally declines through the 1990s and 2000s, ending around 650 to 700 thousand barrels per day after 2005.
